entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is a piece of garbage. It's completely inaccurate.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can try to help you troubleshoot that. Sometimes a quick reset or a software update can fix readings like that.
Look, I don't have time to play tech support. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility. One moment.
Okay, I see your order. It looks like it was delivered 34 days ago. Let me check the policy... yes, our policy allows for returns within 90 days.

You're well within that window, so I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll get a full refund once we receive it.
Fine. I'll look for the email.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
